candidates.name: Idle backlight dimming
candidates.user_value: Reduce glare and backlight power while keeping the required UI illuminated.
candidates.implementation_cost: Low; use existing GPIO6 LEDC control and an isolated host-tested policy module.
candidates.risk: A low brightness could appear black; the idle floor is now 120/255, but optical visibility is unmeasured.
candidates.verification_method: Host C boundary test at 59,999 and 60,000 ms; operator checks visibility after 60 seconds and brightness restoration after BOOT.
candidates.selection_reason: Smallest resource and recovery cost; does not depend on new hardware or weaken the frame receiver.

candidates.name: IMU tilt navigation
candidates.user_value: Change pages or orientation without pressing BOOT.
candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; initialize I2C and QMI8658, filter samples, set thresholds, debounce, and handle sensor failure.
candidates.risk: Movement could trigger accidental page changes and interfere with explicit navigation.
candidates.verification_method: Controlled static poses and tilt sequences with false-trigger, debounce, and recovery observations on hardware.
candidates.selection_reason: BOOT already provides required navigation; the sensor adds failure and false-trigger paths to that core interaction.

candidates.name: RTC time context
candidates.user_value: Show a local clock next to source observation times.
candidates.implementation_cost: Medium; add RTC access, validity checks, and a fallback for unset or lost time.
candidates.risk: RTC backup power and clock validity are unconfirmed; a stale clock could misstate source age.
candidates.verification_method: Compare a set RTC with a trusted reference and test unset and lost-backup states without inventing time.
candidates.selection_reason: Source timestamps already arrive in the frame, while board facts do not establish a trusted RTC clock or backup supply.
